subject: approaching world models - building on existing curation wkflws at Franka/Agile
text:
Hi [NAME],

Been working on a few pieces on identifying dataset quality and the certain
environments where robotic models fail which the Agile/Franka team have
raised as a priority for you guys in the past.

With your new focus on world models - imagine this becomes even more
critical when dealing with larger, irregular and multimodal datasets. Seen
teams who move from video -> world models focus on leveraging complex
curation workflows to achieve this. Is this how you guys are thinking about
this too?

We've been working with Embodied AI and World Models teams at Boston
Dynamics, Wayve etc. - would love to connect and share the learnings across
the industry.

Do you have some this or next week - suggesting Weds/Thurs afternoons?

Let me know and we can get something on the calendar

subject: Scaling annotation pipelines // learnings from Tractable & UVeye
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed AUTO1 is rolling out its damage detection tech to new production
centres across Europe and is hiring across MLOps. Looks like you may be
scaling your vision platform and data annotation pipelines so thought that
it could be worth a quick introduction.

For context, Encord works with leading computer vision teams including
those in the damage detection space e.g. Tractable and UVeye - providing
the platform + services to help scale their multimodal annotation
pipelines.

Would be great to be introduced & happy to share how we've supported some
of your peers in the damage detection space.

Are you open to a quick chat later this week / early next?
